lines.text: Two days before Passover, the chief priests and scribes sought a covert way to arrest Jesus, but not during the feast.
At Simon the Leper's home in Jericho, a woman broke an alabaster jar of perfume and poured it on Jesus' head.
Some present scolded her, saying the perfume could have been sold for over three hundred denarii, the money given to the poor.
Jesus said she anointed His body for burial, and what she did would be told in memory of her.
